“Perplexity’s search capabilities are simply unparalleled”

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Viet Q Nguyen (@VietQNguyen); megjelent: 2026-11-06T05:20:21+00:00; link: https://x.com/VietQNguyen/status/2118574184255365384; média: nincs média]
After several hours of trying out Teammates, I can definitely say it works very well as a complement to GrokBot — especially when using Notion for shared memory. Perplexity’s search capabilities are simply unparalleled. They provide an excellent second set of eyes against what GrokBot’s (also amazing) agentic capabilities bring to bear. 

I can’t decide between these two awesome ecosystems and I don’t have to. 

Watch in awe when GrokBots and Teammates swarm in developing BD lead generation, filling in details and enhancing data for sales conversions. Turning on deep research and hard thinking to uncover new strategies for making targeted sales approaches. 

A new world we live in.
